Findings

1. **The scenes, line 172, last sentence, against lines 113, 148 and 181 (ruling 5: what a scene's save list commits the state to).** The new list says the showing saves `cycle` as "the clutch, with its first asker at the stone". That holds for `seek` and `who`. For the first `alike` clutch it does not: line 113 has nobody asking, line 148 says nobody asks until the first one is let out, and line 181 says the stone stays empty until then, while the pair that shows goes up the hill. So after the `alike` showing `cycle.asker` is nothing, and a test written from line 172 would fail on it. Replace the last sentence of the bullet with:
 ``Saved when it starts: `shown` (the way of asking), `hill` (the pair that shows, in its place, and whoever made way for it gone), `rng`, and with them what the same touch brings in: `finished` (no longer), `cycle` (the clutch, with its first asker at the stone, or in an `alike` clutch with nobody at the stone) and `next` (nothing).``
 This changes no rule of the game; it brings the list into line with the three lines above.

## From the lead

One more, a ruling on something the checker saw and did not count. Handle it with the finding above; the next round reads your sentence as new text.

2. **The scenes: the last reunion or finding, followed on the same touch by the ending.** Each is "saved when it starts", so a game put away during the first of the two holds every hide done, `finished` not yet set and nobody at the edge, and the sheet does not say what a load then shows. The ruling: whatever a later scene will save is saved with the scene that makes it certain. Add one sentence of your own to the "Saved when it starts" list of the last reunion and of the finding that says so: when it is the last of its clutch, the fields the ending saves are written in the same save, so a game put away then is found with its cycle finished and plays no ending on load. Make the rules do the same, with a test.
